editorial:
Imagine you are just a regular person trying to get by in a tough city. That is exactly where you find Shen Te, a kind girl who is the only person willing to help some strangers who turn out to be gods in disguise. Because she is so sweet, the gods give her a gift that changes her life overnight. You get to watch her go from having nothing to suddenly having a home and money, but the vibe quickly shifts. Instead of a fairy tale, you see how her kindness actually makes her a target for everyone around her who just wants a piece of her pie.

What really sticks with you is how the main actress handles the stress of being too nice. The acting is great, and it makes you think about whether it is actually possible to be a good person when everyone else is selfish. Some parts feel a bit slow, but the drama keeps you interested. If you want to see this one, you should try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for anyone who likes stories about morality and human nature.
endingExplained: By the end, Shen Te realizes she cannot be kind and survive at the same time. She creates a fake, mean version of herself to handle the greedy people. In the final scene, she asks the gods for help one last time. Instead of giving her a real answer, the gods tell her to keep trying and hope for the best. It ends on a sad note because she is still stuck in a broken world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about the struggle between being good and being practical.
